ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Binary Proxy Execution Via VSDiagnostics.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "VSDiagnostics.exe" with the "start" command in order to launch and proxy arbitrary binaries.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\VSDiagnostics\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "VSDiagnostics\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*start.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/launch\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-launch\\:.*")))
